sr_summary: Interactive SQL sandbox: a preloaded two-table database with an editable query box and results table, for exploring LEFT JOIN with the filter in ON versus WHERE.
schema_summary:
authors(id, name)          books(id, author_id, title, year)
1  Ada                     1  1  Analytical Engine   1843
2  Grace                   2  1  Notes on Bernoulli  1842
3  Linus                   3  2  Compiler Design     1952

presets.label: Filter in ON
presets.sql:
SELECT a.name, b.title
FROM authors a
LEFT JOIN books b
  ON b.author_id = a.id
 AND b.year > 1842;

presets.label: Filter in WHERE
presets.sql:
SELECT a.name, b.title
FROM authors a
LEFT JOIN books b
  ON b.author_id = a.id
WHERE b.year > 1842;

presets.label: No filter
presets.sql:
SELECT a.name, b.title
FROM authors a
LEFT JOIN books b
  ON b.author_id = a.id;

presets.label: What WHERE tests
presets.sql:
SELECT a.name, b.title, b.year > 1842 AS where_test
FROM authors a
LEFT JOIN books b
  ON b.author_id = a.id;
